install.description: Writes the drop-in, validates the full configuration with sshd -t before it goes live, then reloads ssh.
install.title: Install SSH hardening

uninstall.description: Removes the drop-in, validates with sshd -t, then reloads ssh. No-op when the drop-in is absent.
uninstall.title: Uninstall SSH hardening

update.description: Reconciles the drop-in to the module's state, validates with sshd -t, then reloads ssh. Same behavior as install.
update.title: Update SSH hardening

verify.description: Read-only check that the drop-in matches the module's state, sshd -t passes and the effective configuration (sshd -T) shows the expected values. Exits non-zero when it does not.
verify.title: Verify SSH hardening

description: Manages a drop-in sshd configuration that pins the port, denies root login, sets the authentication mode, limits attempts and restricts access to the listed users and groups. The live configuration is never touched while it does not pass sshd -t. Targets Debian 12/13 and Ubuntu 22.04/24.04.
name: ssh-hardening
title: SSH hardening
